title: Claymation breakfast
prompt_en: Stop-motion claymation, 16:9. A clay fried egg hops out of a pan onto a plate, followed by two strips of bacon that wiggle into a smile shape. Visible fingerprints on clay, slightly choppy 12fps feel, warm kitchen set.
prompt_zh: 黏土定格动画，16:9。黏土荷包蛋从锅里跳到盘子上，两条培根扭动着排成笑脸。黏土上可见指纹，略带卡顿的 12fps 感，温暖的厨房布景。
why_it_works: Explicitly asking for frame-rate choppiness and fingerprints tells the model to avoid overly smooth CG motion.
